recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up portrait of a man with dark hair and a full beard, characterized by a warm, orange-toned skin glow and heavy analog film grain. The composition is tightly cropped, focusing on the eyes and bridge of the nose, with typography tucked into the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Tight crop to facial features creates intimacy and intensity
Warm skin tones contrast against dark hair and deep shadows
Small, heavy typography balances the large-scale facial features
Analog grain provides a tactile, historical texture
coreInvariants: High-contrast lighting with deep blacks in the hair and beard

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies 90% of the frame, centered horizontally but cropped at the forehead and chin.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned slightly above the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the mustache/beard, then travels to the small text in the top right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; limited to the dark areas of the hair and the corners of the frame.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (hair, beard, shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the mid-tones of the skin; low value in the surrounding hair.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and warm highlights

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy slab serif for all text elements to maintain 70s utility feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serifs and blocky structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-detail, extreme close-up portrait of a man with a thick beard and dark hair. Use warm, 1970s-style analog film aesthetic with heavy grain and saturated amber skin tones. Crop tightly on the eyes and nose.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase text in the top right corner using a heavy slab serif font in a muted rust-orange color. Keep the text small relative to the face.

verificationChecks: Is the crop tight enough to cut off the top of the head?
Is the skin tone noticeably warm/orange?
Is the film grain visible and consistent?
Is the font a heavy slab serif?

postGenerationChecks: Check for heavy analog grain across the entire image
Ensure the eyes are the primary focal point
Verify the slab serif text is positioned in the upper right
Confirm the absence of cool colors like bright blue or cyan
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme close-up portrait + 1970s analog film grain + warm amber lighting + corner-aligned heavy slab serif typography.
